summary: Tremulous is a free/open-source asymmetric team FPS/RTS built on ioquake3, with current preservation tied to official 1.1.0 downloads, community clients, and server availability.

entries.title: Tremulous
entries.definitive_edition: Official Tremulous 1.1.0 package, with server/client state documented

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Documented client/package connected to a recorded server/map state

primary.version: Official 1.1.0 package or documented community client
primary.why: Tremulous is multiplayer and open-source, so archive fidelity depends on exact client, assets, server, map, and community patch state. The official 1.1.0 package is the baseline, while 1.2 previews/community clients should be labeled.
primary.how_to_play: Use the official package or a documented community client. Record client/version, OS, server, map, team, class/evolution/build points, player/bot count, mods, asset package, and whether Unvanquished or 1.2 preview routes were excluded.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record server, map, client, mod, and player-count state.
